description: Researches a company from its website and public sources and writes a company profile: what it sells, who buys it, traction, funding, team, hiring, tech stack, key people, red flags and the gaps you still need to fill, every claim tagged with a source and a confidence level. Use it as the first file in a marketing context folder, or to prep a discovery call or qualify a prospect. Triggers: "company research", "company background", "company context for", "qualify this prospect", "discovery call prep", "account brief", or a company URL handed over for research. Not for competitor analysis (use /competitor-research) or customer profiles (use /icp-research).
